_meta.purpose: Registry of approved ChatGPT masters in brand-assets/cut-guides/. Each entry records identity (md5, pixels), what the master decides (coverage and look), the statements on it that disagree with a sourced record (defects), and its publish gate. A master is visual direction. Its text is never transcribed into a record. Where it disagrees with a record, the record wins and the master returns to the ChatGPT lane for regeneration with the defect list as the brief.
_meta.creative_lane_rule: ChatGPT owns creative. Claude may upscale, outpaint, clean, and re-typeset an approved master. Claude may not reinterpret it, change its concept, or generate a replacement.
_meta.print_requirement: 18 x 24 in at 300 dpi = 5400 x 7200 px. 24 x 36 in = 7200 x 10800 px. Every master below is 1024 to 1149 px wide, roughly one fifth of poster resolution. None may go to print at native resolution. Web use at up to 1100 px CSS width is fine.
_meta.publish_gate_rule: No species master is published on the site until (a) pitlog.app/recipes exists and (b) every recipe the master names by title has a live page at least at TEST_V1, and (c) the master's safety defects are fixed or the surrounding page corrects them in text. A guide graphic that names a recipe is a promise.

masters.subject: chicken
masters.format: full infographic, 6 numbered regions, Smoked Chicken Thighs recipe

defects.text_on_master: 'Breast meat dries out quickly above 170 F. Pull at 160-165 F and rest.'
defects.fix: Pulling at 160 F is below the USDA minimum; carryover is not a safety mechanism. Must read 'cook to 165 F'.

defects.text_on_master: 'USDA safe temperature (all cuts) 165 F ... Rest 3 minutes' and 'Always cook chicken to at least 165 F and rest for 3 minutes'
defects.fix: USDA requires no rest for poultry. The 3 minute rest belongs to the 145 F red-meat rule. Remove or relabel as optional.

defects.text_on_master: Diagram numbers 3 as DRUMSTICK and 4 is missing; legend lists 3 THIGH, 4 DRUMSTICK. The thigh has no callout on the bird.

masters.publish_gate: BLOCKED: variant not selected; two safety defects; diagram defect
